title: Abelian Varieties
version: January 2, 2022 corrected reprint of Arithmetic Geometry (1986), Chapter V

used_locators.scope: Poincare complete reducibility, used to turn a proper connected subgroup of E^3 into a nonzero endomorphism relation.
Multiplication by n is finite etale on an abelian scheme when n is invertible; division-point extensions are unramified at such good primes.

Nondegenerate Galois-equivariant torsion pairing; with canonical elliptic selfduality gives mu_m contained in Q(E[m]). Used only for illustrative splitting/obstruction examples in EKX4, not its essential proof.

role: External theorem interface; not claimed to be reproved by finite checks.
